Governo.titolo: Riunione sull'Ucraina del "Formato di Berlino" e incontro con il Presidente Zelensky
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha partecipato oggi a Dublino, a margine del Vertice della Comunità politica europea, alla riunione sull'Ucraina del "Formato di Berlino". L'incontro è stata l’occasione per riaffermare il pieno sostegno all'Ucraina, anche alla luce dei recenti colloqui trilaterali di Abu Dhabi.

Governo.titolo: Riunione della Coalizione europea contro le droghe
Governo.descrizione: A margine del Vertice della Comunità politica europea di Dublino, il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, e il Presidente della Repubblica francese, Emmanuel Macron, hanno presieduto una nuova riunione dei leader della Coalizione europea contro le droghe (ECAD), iniziativa promossa congiuntamente da Italia e Francia.

Governo.descrizione: A margine del Vertice della Comunità politica europea di Dublino, il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha incontrato il Primo Ministro del Regno Unito, Andy Burnham. Governo.titolo: Definizione del protocollo operativo comune per la gestione delle segnalazioni di allarme
Governo.descrizione: Nel corso della riunione del Comitato interministeriale per la sicurezza della Repubblica (CISR), convocato per oggi pomeriggio a livello tecnico, sarà definito un protocollo operativo comune per la gestione delle segnalazioni di allarme.

Governo.titolo: Dipendenze, a Palazzo Chigi il tavolo per il nuovo Piano d'azione nazionale
Governo.descrizione: Si è svolta nella Sala Verde di Palazzo Chigi la riunione del tavolo sulle dipendenze presieduta dal Sottosegretario alla Presidenza del Consiglio con delega alle politiche contro la droga e le altre dipendenze, Alfredo Mantovano.

Governo.titolo: Il Presidente Meloni a Bologna e San Lazzaro di Savena
Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha visitato questo pomeriggio l’Esposizione Internazionale di Macchine per l'Agricoltura e il Giardinaggio (EIMA), presso BolognaFiere. A seguire il Presidente ha visitato Conserve Italia, in occasione del cinquantesimo anniversario del Gruppo aderente a Confcooperative, a San Lazzaro di Savena (BO).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Search is on for Africa’s most promising blue economy businesses
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The call for pitchers for BlueInvest Africa 2027 has started! African entrepreneurs who are developing innovative and sustainable solutions for the blue economy are invited to apply. The call remains open until 31 December 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Speech by President von der Leyen at the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31)
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Speech by President von der Leyen at the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31)

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Join EAfA’s webinar on integrating basic skills in apprenticeships
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 19 November, from 11:00-12:30 CET, the European Alliance for Apprenticeships will host a webinar to discuss how to integrate basic skills development in apprenticeship programmes and present the upcoming EAfA toolkit tackling this important topic.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Register for joint Pact for Skills–EAfA webinar on cross-border labour mobility and skills portability
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Pact for Skills and the European Alliance for Apprenticeships (EAfA) are hosting a Knowledge Exchange Event on cooperation in EU cross-border regions. The webinar will take place on 17 November 2026 from 11:00–12:30 CET

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Agreement reached on 2027 fishing opportunities for the Baltic Sea
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Council of the European Union reached a political agreement on the fishing opportunities in the Baltic Sea for 2027, following the Commission proposal made in August this year.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission seeks feedback on limited assurance standards for sustainability reporting
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The consultation invites feedback on the Committee of European Auditing Oversight Bodies’ (CEAOB) technical advice, as well as on their proposed adjustments to the international standard.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The results of EUDA Drug Survey: 6 in 10 people in the EU see drug trafficking and drug use as serious problems
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: European Union Drugs Agency (EUDA) published the results of Drug Survey on how people across Europe view drugs, their impact and how society should respond. The EUDA surveyed 95 883 people (aged 15 and over) in 35 European countries, including respondents in the 27 EU countries.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU-Armenia: New agreements on closer cooperation in the areas of customs and taxation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: EU and Armenia today signed two agreements between the EU and Armenia on Armenia’s participation in the EU’s Customs and Fiscalis programmes.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: Emergency oil stocks slightly down; commercial stocks up in July 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In July 2026, the EU held 103.5 million tonnes of emergency oil stocks. Compared with June 2026, emergency oil stocks decreased by 2.5%, while compared with July 2025, the drop was more substantial, at 4.2%.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Young leaders help shape the future of EU international partnerships at Youth Policy Dialogue with Commissioner Síkela
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today in Brussels, European Commissioner for International Partnerships Jozef Síkela met with 29 young leaders from around the world for the second Youth Policy Dialogue on International Partnerships.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU steps up support for Ukraine’s recovery, reconstruction and modernisation, opening new opportunities for businesses
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission helped to bring together more than 5,000 representatives from Ukrainian and international businesses, government institutions, financial organisations and international partners at the EU-Ukraine Investment Conference, held during the ReBuild Ukraine Expo in Warsaw.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission welcomes Nederlandse Spoorwegen's new sales policy for railway vehicles and closes antitrust investigation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has decided to close its preliminary antitrust probe into allegedly anticompetitive behaviour by the Dutch State-owned rail incumbent Nederlandse Spoorwegen (‘NS').

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Drone Summit charts the course for a competitive, innovative and secure European drone market
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Europe’s drone community convened in Brussels on 9-10 November for the EU Drone Summit, a two-day conference on the future of drone operations in the EU.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches two flagship security initiatives under the Pact for Mediterranean
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, at the first Senior Officials' Meeting on Internal Security between the European Union and Southern Mediterranean partners, Commissioner for the Mediterranean Dubravka Šuica launched two flagship regional security initiatives under the third pillar of the Pact for the Mediterranean.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Lahbib travels to Greenland as EU steps up Arctic preparedness cooperation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Wildfires, landslides, tsunamis, avalanches and flooding from ice melt are among natural hazards in Greenland, which are expected to become more frequent as a consequence of global warming. These threats pose particular challenges for remote communities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Cities Forum is back on 2-4 June 2027
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Cities Forum 2027, the European Commission and European Urban Initiative’s flagship event on sustainable urban development will take place from 2 to 4 June in Bilbao, Spain.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Join the consultation to modernise the European Training Foundation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Help shape the future of EU skills development by submitting your evidence for the European Training Foundation renewal by 11 December 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The European Commission explores implementation challenges and reflects on the state of EU-level support on Research Security
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commissioner Zaharieva met with stakeholders through an Implementation Dialogue on Research Security.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Making your online experience fairer
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission presented its proposal for a Digital Fairness Act, a major update of the EU consumer protection rules to ensure that consumers in the EU enjoy the same high level of protection online as they do offline.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission to advance Ukraine's recovery, reconstruction, and modernisation at EU-Ukraine Investment Conference
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 12 and 13 November, the European Commission, together with Ukrainian authorities, will host the EU-Ukraine Investment Conference at the ReBuild Ukraine Expo in Warsaw. The conference, which will be opened by Commissioner for Enlargement Marta Kos and Ukraine's Minister of Economy and Environment

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Remediation of landfill leachate: study looks at microbiomes that break down toxic chemicals from municipal waste
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Leachate from landfill sites can be detoxified by microbes, including any that are found within. New research explores the factors that influence the composition of these microbiomes, with a view to optimising them as a treatment solution.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Reduce, Re-use, Recycle, Recover: lessons for applying the ‘4R’ concept in industrial redevelopment
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: When industry closes down, what’s the best option for the buildings left behind? A study has looked at how circular economy principles have been applied to former breweries, factories and mines in Poland.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Local connections matter for adopting circular practices in construction
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: How can we encourage circularity in the construction sector? A study of building firms’ practices in Italy suggests that local relationships may hold one key to improving sustainability.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU will step up cooperation with Yemen on maritime security
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In view of the Houthis’ continued military escalation in Yemen, their attacks in the region and the continued threats to freedom of navigation in Bab al-Mandab, the Commission will step up its support to Yemen on maritime security.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: First USI-IRA call under EDIP attracts a high number of proposals from Member States and Ukraine
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The first ever USI-IRA call attracted 58 proposals from 11 member States and Ukraine.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Nigeria sign readmission agreement furthering cooperation on migration and security
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 10 November, the EU and the Federal Republic of Nigeria signed a readmission agreement, marking an important step in their partnership on migration and security. Commissioner Brunner represented the EU at the signing ceremony, underlining that this is part of a wider partnership on migration.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €2 billion Belgian State aid to support offshore wind energy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved a €2.04 billion Belgian scheme to support offshore wind energy in line with the objectives of the Clean Industrial Deal.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Discover the new interactive ECO Country Fact Sheets
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Construction Observatory (ECO) has launched its first set of revamped Country Fact Sheets, featuring a new interactive design that makes it easier to explore and understand the construction ecosystem across EU countries.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Are you shaping the future of Africa’s blue economy? Apply to pitch at BlueInvest Africa 2027!
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The search is on for Africa’s most promising blue economy businesses! The call for pitchers for BlueInvest Africa 2027 is now open. African entrepreneurs developing innovative and sustainable solutions for the blue economy have until 31 December 2026 to apply

Commissione, notizie.titolo: High-Level Platform meets in Moldova to strengthen digital connectivity between the EU, the Black Sea region, South-Caucasus and Central Asia
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Yesterday and today, the first High-Level Connectivity Platform Meeting on Digital takes place in Chișinău, Moldova, jointly hosted by the European Commission and the Moldovan Ministry of Economic Development and Digitalisation.
